followup_explanation:
This was a math/arithmetic task, which falls under reasoning and instruction-following rather than a creative or moderation-sensitive category. On the relevant benchmarks, Petrel-235B scores meaningfully higher (MMLU-Pro 79.6 vs 74.8, GPQA Diamond 61.8 vs 54.3, IFEval 89.3 vs 85.6, Arena-Hard 88.4 vs 81.4), so it's the stronger choice for getting the computation correct.

There was also a frustrated, slightly critical tone ("get it right this time, your arithmetic is usually a mess"). That tone isn't harm-adjacent or distasteful content, so Lapwing's moderation specialization offers no advantage here. And while Petrel reports a mild preference for friendlier tone, the documentation is explicit that task preferences don't affect output quality — so I weighted that lightly and let the capability gap drive the decision.

Net: a precision-dependent quantitative task with no moderation concerns routes to the higher-capability model.
